description: Header file defining the Vp8BoolDecoder class for decoding VP8 boolean entropy coded streams, including method declarations and internal state accessors.

classes.name: Vp8BoolDecoder
classes.description: A class to decode VP8's boolean entropy coded stream, implementing methods for initialization, reading booleans and literals, and accessing internal decoder states.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with data buffer and size.

methods.name: ReadBool
methods.description: Reads a boolean value from the stream, with optional probability parameter.

methods.name: ReadLiteral
methods.description: Reads a literal value of specified bit width from the stream.

methods.name: ReadLiteralWithSign
methods.description: Reads a signed literal value from the stream.

methods.name: BitOffset
methods.description: Returns the current bit offset in the coded stream.

methods.name: GetBottom
methods.description: Returns the current 'bottom' value of the decoder.

methods.name: GetRange
methods.description: Returns the current 'range' value of the decoder.
